findings.summary: Typed-array `includes` compared through `array_index_of`, so `Float32Array.of(NaN).includes(NaN)` was false; `array_includes` uses SameValueZero for typed and number arrays.
UTF-8 decoding had a second validator and BOM path; `decode_utf8` gained a fatal mode and `text_decode` uses the shared decoders.
TextDecoder options re-implemented listener option parsing; `compileBooleanOptions` serves both and accepts shorthand and stored option records.

Buffer-source unions had their own mapper requiring an ArrayBuffer member; `fromMixedUnion` maps any union of library binary classes with one `instanceof` path, `isBinaryDataType` names the family, and `decode()` accepts the union value.
A fifth `array_index_of` overload and a hand-built number list; one template and `array_from_iterable` replace them.
Typed-array methods restated the array method dispatch; one tail (search, value methods, span gate, handlers) serves arrays, spans and typed arrays.
Each opaque kind needed six parallel edits; one opaque sink, a symbol/library/kind table and an `opaqueLeaf` helper replace them.
The WeakRef rationale was stated four times and `data:locale` reached twice; each is stated or reached once.
A Collator went through the bounded collator cache on every compare; it now owns its ICU collator, opened at construction.
`map`, `filter` and `TypedArray.from(src, fn)` built an intermediate number array; they fill the typed array directly.
Numeric `sort()` copied, sorted and wrote back; owned storage sorts in place.
TextDecoder validated then decoded, and TextEncoder transcoded through UTF-16; decode returns well-formed bytes after one pass and encode is one WTF-8 byte pass.
Fixtures merged where two tested the same shape, a duplicated assertion dropped, a mixed refusal test split; the Binary data, Async and Intl rows reworded as facts.
An immediate `await p.catch(() => fallback)` escalates the program to the application realm; lowering it in place outside a realm would avoid the escalation.
findings.blockedBy: Lowering the fallback in place needs the fallback's result type joined with the promise's in the outside-a-realm promise model; the reached programs also catch a retained promise, which needs the realm regardless.
